torque_basis.meaning: the previous, much tighter torque baseline, kept as an independent rollback path
torque_basis.note: the red lines are identical to the 3.5 baseline; only the torque ceiling differs

provenance: Retained so a rollback is an explicit, auditable version choice rather than an in-place edit of a file's contents.
It does NOT participate in default selection: only load_safety_baseline("0.25") picks it up.
warnings: ★ NOT VERIFIED ON THIS UNIT — same caveat as safety_limits_350.json: the interval is the reference unit's measurement, to be re-derived before real-hardware motion.
★ This is a deliberately conservative ceiling, not a measured one: expect normal grasps to be torque-limited by it.
invariants: A config file may only NARROW this baseline; any attempt to widen it is rejected.
